card.name: Files and capsules after verbs
card.fires_on: The noun after an action verb or drug name, mainly 'file(s)' in computer text and 'capsules' after a drug name in dosing instructions. Also 'As' in 'Save As'.

modes.label: Capsules after drug name
modes.description: The word capsules following a drug name in resume or discontinue instructions.
modes.example: Resume lenalidomide<< capsules>> at 5 mg less than the previous

modes.label: File in computer text
modes.description: The word file or files, or 'As' in 'Save As', in web and software instructions.
modes.example: Click the File menu, and then click Save<< As>>.

card.writes: Mixed output with no clear theme, though it weakly suppresses admin and file-related tokens.
card.plain: It marks the object word right after a drug name or a save/include verb, such as capsules or file.
